actions.name: Configuration Inventory
actions.description: Configuration inventory identifies and records the configuration of software and hardware and their components throughout the organization.
actions.reason: Configuration inventory is foundational for developing policies, as it provides the baseline data needed to define and implement configuration management controls.

actions.name: System Configuration Permissions
actions.description: Restricting system configuration modifications to a specific user or group of users.
actions.reason: Restricting configuration modifications to specific users directly supports policy enforcement by limiting unauthorized changes to system configurations.

actions.name: Access Policy Administration
actions.description: Access policy administration is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions to resources.
actions.reason: Access policy administration systematically defines and manages access control policies, which is essential for creating procedures around configuration management.

subgoals.embedding_context: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security impact prior to change implementation

actions.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: Evaluates system vulnerabilities to assess how changes might affect overall system security.

actions.name: Network Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: Network vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a network's components in the context of their configuration and interdependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the network's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual network node or network segment vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: Evaluates network vulnerabilities to determine how changes could impact network security.

actions.name: User Session Init Config Analysis
actions.description: Analyzing modifications to user session config files such as .bashrc or .bash_profile.
actions.reason: Analyzes user session config files to detect potential security risks from configuration changes.

actions.name: Process Self-Modification Detection
actions.description: Detects processes that modify, change, or replace their own code at runtime.
actions.reason: Detects self-modifying processes that could indicate malicious behavior from system changes.
